bindingKindDescriptions.PROCESS_ONLY: The value stays in the process response and is not written directly to HR data.
bindingKindDescriptions.DOMAIN_READ: The server reads an explicitly allowed HR projection. The value is always read-only.
bindingKindDescriptions.DOMAIN_PROPOSAL: The value is stored as a typed proposal and is applied only by an explicit domain commit.
bindingKindDescriptions.COMPUTED: The server calculates the value from process context. Participants cannot change it.

bindingEntryDescriptions.process-only: A free process field for answers, explanation, and decision information.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employee-current-employee: The employee to whom the process relates.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employee-current-employment: The employment to which the process relates.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employee-current-department: The subject's current department on the process date.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employee-current-job: The subject's current job on the process date.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employee-current-manager: The subject's current manager on the process date.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employee-current-name: The subject's name from the HR projection.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employee-document: A document reference released by the document adapter.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employment-current-starts-on: The start date of the selected employment.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employment-current-ends-on: The end date of the selected employment, when present.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employment-current-type: The typed employment type as a read value.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employment-current-contract-type: The contract type as a read value.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employment-change-target-department: A department changed by a domain proposal.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employment-change-target-job: A job changed by a domain proposal.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employment-change-effective-on: The effective date changed by a domain proposal.
bindingEntryDescriptions.subject-has-employee: Computes whether process context contains an employee.
bindingEntryDescriptions.subject-has-employment: Computes whether process context contains an employment.
bindingEntryDescriptions.subject-has-department: Computes whether process context contains a department.
bindingEntryDescriptions.subject-display-name: Computes a safe display name for the subject.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employment-tenure-years: Computes tenure in years on the business effective date.
bindingEntryDescriptions.process-business-effective-date: Reads the business effective date from server context.
bindingEntryDescriptions.employment-active-on-business-date: Computes whether employment is active on the business effective date.
